stem: A business cancelled Voltmarkt's Business Care subscription (a monthly device-support plan for small offices) in March 2025 and subscribed again in May 2026. How does it count in the net revenue retention measured from 1 October 2025 to 1 October 2026?

options.text: As expansion, because its MRR rose from zero during the window
In the starting cohort, because it had been a customer before October 2025
Not at all: it had no MRR on 1 October 2025, so it is not in the cohort
As a cancelled business, at zero MRR at the end of the window
